title: node_slot_raw's slot-0 fallback silently resolves unmatched ids to slot 0 — latent wrong-state/OOB trap if a caller skips validation
detail: An unmatched id silently resolves to slot 0: wrong node's span cached, or an OOB node_pos[0] read on an empty topology. Unreachable today only because topology_apply_edit validates first; any future skip-validation caller corrupts state silently.
recommended_fix: Return (u32, bool) from node_slot_raw or assert inside apply_draw; the fallback should fail loud (replay_error-style latch), never resolve to slot 0.

title: W1 truncation mutation underflows on a 0-byte log: unguarded len(src)-1 feeds a negative length to make() → crash instead of rejection
detail: Every other mutation length-guards (len(src) > 24/28/0/4/41); truncation does not. An empty blessed log makes len(src)-1 = -1, a runtime panic in the W1 harness — a crash where the gate should cleanly reject.
recommended_fix: Guard truncation like the others: only append when len(src) > 0. An empty log should be skipped or reported, never passed to make() with a negative length.

title: Demo names flow unsanitized into golden/tmp write paths — traversal is CLI-reachable (harness run|save <name>) though not from the CI demos/ listing
detail: os.read_dir basenames cannot contain '/', so CI (drift-check, run) is safe and m.label is hardcoded; but `harness run/save <name>` accepts CLI args, so a crafted name plus a matching demo file writes mkdir/ExportImage output outside goldens/. Developer-tool defense-in-depth only.
recommended_fix: Reject demo names containing '/' or '..' at the CLI boundary (and defensively in log_path/golden_path) before any write path.

title: jint narrows i64 JSON integers to i32 unchecked — out-of-range catalog values silently wrap into the valid range instead of fail-fast
detail: json.Integer is i64; the i32 truncation wraps e.g. 0x100000064 to 100, passing the 1..1000 logic_hz check despite the file's fail-fast contract. Determinism survives (catalog_hash binds raw bytes), but out-of-range data is silently accepted, not rejected.
recommended_fix: Range-check before narrowing: validate the i64 in its own domain (e.g. reject when outside i32 range) before assigning to the i32 field.
